title: decussocarpus minus
intro: Decussocarpus minus, commonly known as the New Zealand fern, is a species of tree fern native to New Zealand and Australia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Decussocarpus minus include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it a potential treatment for infections and autoimmune disorders. The bioactive constituents of Decussocarpus minus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
